[Intro]
[D]

[Verse 1]
[D]I've been waiting on the fault line
Living evil take me on
I'll be standing with my dying bed
If you care to come along

[Chorus]
[C]Racing with the rising [G]tide To my father's
[D]door
[C]Racing with the rising [G]tide To my father's
[D]door

[Verse 2]
[D]I been lying in the bright light
See my shadow from below
Never wanted from another man
Never wanted for my own

[Chorus]
[C]Drowning in the rising [G]tide At my father's
[D]door
[C]Drowning in the rising [G]tide At my father's
[D]door

[Solo]
[D]

[Verse 3]
[D]Through a window to the last mile
My living picture on a wall
From the banks of the far side
I see the lights come ashore

[Chorus]

[D]door
